summary: First-run E2E of HostNesia. Backend: 15/16 pytest passed, 1 skipped (insufficient-balance case not reproducible without draining saldo). Frontend: login, dashboard cards, Quick Actions dropdown, Order form (creates service+invoice), Top-up dialog (balance 1.500.000 -> 1.600.000), Billing tabs (Tagihan/Riwayat Transaksi), Profile + Logout, and protected-route redirect all work. One functional bug found: invoice IDs collide when multiple orders happen in the same minute, blocking payment of the correct invoice.

critical.issue: Generated invoice id uses only minute-precision timestamp (`INV-%Y%m%d%H%M`). Two orders within the same minute produce identical invoice IDs. `pay_invoice` then hits the wrong document (whichever Mongo returns first) and can respond 400 'Tagihan sudah dibayar' for a newly-created unpaid invoice. Also causes duplicate React key warnings on frontend. Fix: append seconds+uuid4[:6] or use uuid entirely.

minor.issue: No de-duplication safeguard — duplicate ids from the bug above surface directly to UI.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Likely a navigate() or setState called during render instead of inside useEffect. Cosmetic but should be fixed.
Duplicate key warning `INV-202608011413` — caused by backend invoice-id collision, but front-end should still tolerate (use composite key with created_at).

integration_issues.flow: Pay invoice after ordering multiple services in the same minute
integration_issues.issue: Because backend invoice IDs collide, POST /api/invoices/{id}/pay may target the earlier (already Paid) invoice and return 400.

action_items: Make invoice id unique in POST /api/services/order (e.g. `INV-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS-<uuid4hex[:6]>`).
Investigate the setState-in-render warning in Login (wrap navigate in useEffect).
Optionally: pay_invoice could scope by (id, user_id, status='Unpaid') to be resilient to id collisions.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoice id generation is not unique — see action_items.
seed() rewrites /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup; fine here but be aware if credentials ever change externally.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True, which browsers reject for credentialed requests. Not currently used (JWT via Authorization header), but flag for future cookie-based auth.
get_current_user does not catch ObjectId(payload['sub']) InvalidId — a malformed 'sub' will 500 instead of 401.
PRODUCTS list is hardcoded; if productization grows, move to DB.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows worked; one blocked pay attempt due to backend id-collision bug)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1 user + 4 services + 4 invoices + 4 transactions on startup. Tests also create one order (`ui-test-order.example.com`) and one topup (+50k in backend test, +100k in UI test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and is stable. The insufficient-balance test auto-skips when saldo covers all invoices; to force it, drain balance by paying all unpaid invoices first. Frontend selectors verified: login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit, quick-actions-dropdown-trigger, order-product-select/order-domain-input/order-submit, topup-open-button/topup-amount-<n>/topup-confirm-button, invoice-pay-<id>, tab-invoices/tab-transactions, logout-button. `qa-order` testid does NOT exist on the Quick Actions dropdown items — items are only reachable by visible text (e.g. 'Order Layanan Baru'); consider adding testids like qa-order/qa-dns/qa-email/qa-filemanager/qa-phpmyadmin.
rca_of_the_issue: Invoice id format `INV-%Y%m%d%H%M` in server.py order_service() truncates to minute precision. When the UI test ordered a service right after the backend pytest ordered one (both within the same minute), both received id `INV-202608011413`. Mongo find_one on this id then returned the earlier, already-paid document, causing pay_invoice to reject with 400 'Tagihan sudah dibayar'. Fix: use `INV-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}`.
